tokens.name: limewash
tokens.usage: Page ground. Named after the lime plaster walls of the villas we run. The default surface for every page.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surface: plan cards, form panels, the header once it turns solid. Never used as the page ground.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate band for a section that needs separation without a colour change. Use at most once between two limewash sections.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers (1px). Decorative only, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, 3:1 on limewash and paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on limewash, paper, stone and teal-tint.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs and secondary copy on limewash, paper, stone and teal-tint.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Captions, sources and spec labels on limewash, paper, stone and teal-tint (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary button fill, text links, active nav, focus ring. As text, on limewash, paper, stone and teal-tint.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill (primary button).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: The one dark band per page: the closing call to action and the footer. Text on it is on-band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on teal-deep.

tokens.name: band-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on teal-deep (7.4:1).

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted panel behind a highlighted figure or the selected plan. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The accent. The logo mark on teal-deep, the 1px rule above a figure, the active underline. Graphic use only, never body text.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text: the single small spec label that needs to stand out, on limewash or paper.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Form errors only, always with a written message beside it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your villa, run like a business.
styles.usage: The hero headline only. One per page. Mobile: display-lg.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headline that opens a chapter of the page. Mobile: heading-1.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Three phases from launch to full rate.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card and plan names, sub-section heads.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Prices and revenue figures. Always paired with a spec-label underneath that says what the number is and where it comes from.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We help owners of 5+ bedroom luxury villas grow rental revenue within 90 days.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display headline. Max 52 characters wide. Colour ink-soft.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: List item heads, form panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You keep the asset; we run the commercial side.
styles.usage: All running text. Max 68 characters wide.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Setup included, billed once a year.
styles.usage: Notes under prices, form hints, footer text.

styles.name: spec-label
styles.usage: Uppercase spec labels in SpecLine and under a figure. Mirrors the legend on an architect's floor plan. Never above a headline as an eyebrow.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Source: AirDNA, Bali 4 bedroom villas, last 12 months.
styles.usage: Photo captions and data sources. Colour ink-mute.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its spec-label; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between list items in a plan card.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; label to input.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Headline to lead; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between form fields groups.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; lead to buttons in the hero.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Standard desktop section padding.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Chapter breaks: before a display-lg headline and around full-bleed photos. Whitespace is the luxury signal.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Photos, bands, the hero. Architecture is square; so are our pictures.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Plan cards, form panels, dialogs. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the 8px status dot. Never a button or a card.

shadow.note: Borders before shadows. The only shadow is for things that float above content.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The solid header after scrolling, menus and dialogs. Nothing else.
